title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Long-Term Care Insurance Benefit in an Additional Deposit
content:
**Insurance assignment desk note — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** Where a long-term care insurer pays on the agreement under an assignment of benefits, the insurer's daily benefit is taken off the daily rate of the additional deposit. "Within the last three months" counts payments whose date is fewer than three whole calendar months before the day the deposit is worked out.

| Insurer payments on the agreement in the last three months | Insurer's daily benefit |
|---|---|
| Three or more | The insurer's most recent payment on the agreement (the one posted first where two share a date) divided by the days of the charge that payment paid; nothing where that charge shows no days |
| One or two | The insurer's payments on the agreement within the last three months divided by 91, the averaging days |
| None | No insurer benefit is taken off |

**Hypothetical cases.** Four insurer payments in the window, the latest 1,500.00 against a charge of 30 days: 50.00 a day. Two payments of 910.00 each: 1,820.00 divided by 91 is 20.00 a day.
